title: Outflow Valve Control Actuator — Installation
abstract: Installation of the outflow valve control actuator and its solenoid at the aft pressure bulkhead, with the null setting and the cabin rate response check that must be recorded before the aircraft is released.

sections.purpose: To install the outflow valve control actuator and its solenoid and to prove the installation with a cabin rate response check on the ground.
sections.job_setup_note: The aircraft must be unpressurised and the cabin pressure system isolated before the actuator is fitted. Access is through the aft cabin and the overhead crew rest area. The null position must be set with the valve fully closed and confirmed with the linkage disconnected before the linkage is reconnected. External power and the ground pressurisation rig are needed for the response check. Two persons are needed.
sections.procedure: Make sure that the aircraft is unpressurised and that the cabin pressure system is isolated. Remove the electrical power and put the warning notices in position. Get access through the aft cabin at zone 253 and the overhead crew rest at zone 285. Clean the actuator mounting face and examine it for distortion. Install the solenoid D2130115199629 on the actuator body and torque the retaining screws AGS149379-16 to 4 Nm. Put the actuator D2130114939430 on the mounting face with the linkage disconnected. Install the flange screws and torque to 9 Nm. CAUTION: DO NOT CONNECT THE LINKAGE BEFORE THE NULL POSITION IS SET. THE ACTUATOR WILL DRIVE THE VALVE AGAINST ITS STOP AND THE GEARBOX WILL BE DAMAGED. Restore the electrical power and set the null position from the maintenance terminal with the valve fully closed. Confirm the null with the linkage still disconnected. Remove the electrical power. Connect the linkage and set the length to the dimension in the task. Install the switch HOL977930-80 and connect the manual mode harness. Install the pump kit JAR222490-37 at the aft equipment position and connect the sensing line. Restore the electrical power and connect the ground pressurisation rig. WARNING: DO NOT ENTER THE AFT EQUIPMENT AREA WHILE THE GROUND PRESSURISATION RIG IS RUNNING. Do the cabin rate response check, commanding a step change in both directions, and record the achieved rate and the overshoot.
sections.close_out: Disconnect the ground pressurisation rig and restore the cabin pressure system. Make sure that the linkage is locked and that no tools remain in the area. Refit the aft cabin and crew rest panels. Remove the warning notices. Record the installation, the serial numbers, the null setting, the linkage length and the recorded rates and overshoots in both directions.

type_data.effectivity_note: Aircraft post MOD-111407 carry the faster rate limiter and a different acceptance band.

safety_precautions: Do not enter the aft equipment area while the ground pressurisation rig is running.
Make sure that the aircraft is unpressurised before the actuator is fitted.
Do not connect the linkage before the null position is set.

tooling.description: Maintenance terminal and load media reader
